subject: Lumenexa security review / onboarding readiness
messages:
From: Priya Desai <priya.desai@lumenexa.com>
To: neha.kapoor@redwood.com
Cc: ajay.kumar@lumenexa.com, procurement@lumenexa.com
Date: 2026-09-28T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: Security review ahead of Redwood demo

Hi Neha —

We’re excited to get the Redwood demo scheduled next week. Before the demo, our security and procurement teams would like a 60-minute security review to cover data handling, network architecture, and evidence around controls (SOC2, encryption, RBAC, logging). Attendees from our side: myself (security), Ajay Kumar (platform eng), and a procurement rep. 

Can you please propose 2x 60-minute windows next week (Mon–Thu)? Also let me know what artifacts you can share in advance (SOC2, questionnaire, data retention policy).

Thanks,
Priya
Priya Desai
Information Security Lead, Lumenexa
[Attachment: none]
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Priya Desai <priya.desai@lumenexa.com>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-28T17:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Security review ahead of Redwood demo

Hi Priya —

Great — thanks for the heads up. I’ve looped in Rishi (SE) and Marissa from our security team so we can align on scope and artifacts. We can absolutely share SOC2 summary and a short security questionnaire up front. 

Proposed 60-min windows (Pacific time):
- Tue 2026-09-29 10:00–11:00 PT
- Wed 2026-09-30 14:00–15:00 PT

If those don’t work, happy to move. I’m attaching our standard security questionnaire — please fill the shaded rows (or flag items you need us to present live).

Next steps: once you confirm a slot, Marissa can lead the technical readout and Rishi will cover deployment/architecture questions. I’ll coordinate procurement items and the mutual action plan.

Neha
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_Security_Questionnaire_v1.xlsx (Excel, 120KB)]
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Priya Desai <priya.desai@lumenexa.com>, neha.kapoor@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-29T09:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Security review ahead of Redwood demo

Hi Priya / team —

Thanks Neha. A couple quick notes from the security side before the session so we can be efficient:
- Please upload any high-level network/VPC diagrams and a sample ingest flow to the Drive link (I’ve added the required evidence checklist there).
- We typically cover: architecture & data flows (30m), controls & attestations (15m), logging/retention/access model (15m).

If it helps, attaching a 1-page SOC2 summary and our expectations matrix. Proposed alternate slots (PT):
- Tue 2026-09-29 11:00–12:00 PT (60m) — tight but doable if Ajay can join at 11
- Wed 2026-09-30 14:00–15:00 PT (60m) — my preference

Artifacts we can provide in advance: SOC2 Type II summary (attached), encryption at-rest/in-transit overview, sample audit log retention policy.

Marissa Cole
Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: SOC2-Type2-summary.pdf (PDF, 480KB)]
From: Priya Desai <priya.desai@lumenexa.com>
To: neha.kapoor@redwood.com
Cc: ajay.kumar@lumenexa.com, procurement@lumenexa.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-29T10:50:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Security review ahead of Redwood demo

Thanks — appreciate the detail. Procurement has a mandatory vendor review at Tue 11:00 that blocks that time. Wed 14:00–15:00 PT looks best for our security folks, but procurement is only available Wed 15:30–16:00 PT.

Could we do Wed 14:00–15:00 focused on technical/security (Marissa + Ajay + Rishi), and then a quick 30-min procurement overlap 15:30–16:00 PT for contract / data residency / SLAs? If that split is okay, I’ll send calendar invites and upload a network diagram to your Drive link.

Also, confirm whether you can share the redacted SOC2 PDF in advance (Marissa’s attached summary is helpful).

—Priya
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Priya Desai <priya.desai@lumenexa.com>, neha.kapoor@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-29T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Security review ahead of Redwood demo

On Wed, Sep 29, 2026 at 10:50 AM Priya Desai <priya.desai@lumenexa.com> wrote:
> Thanks — appreciate the detail. Procurement has a mandatory vendor review at Tue 11:00 that blocks that time. Wed 14:00–15:00 PT looks best for our security folks, but procurement is only available Wed 15:30–16:00 PT.

That split works for us. Proposal:
- Wed 2026-09-30 14:00–14:45 PT — security & architecture (Marissa leads)
- Wed 2026-09-30 14:45–15:00 PT — optional overlap / Q&A (short break)
- Wed 2026-09-30 15:30–16:00 PT — procurement sync (Neha leads)

I’ll prepare a 10-slide tech runbook we can share in the security slot and add a short architecture diagram. Uploading now: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-Lumenexa-Redwood-evidence

Rishi Malhotra
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood-technical-readout.pptx (pptx, 320KB)]
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Priya Desai <priya.desai@lumenexa.com>, procurement@lumenexa.com
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-29T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: Confirmed: Wed 2026-09-30 security + procurement cadence & mutual action plan

Confirmed — thank you all. Summary / MAP:
- Wed 2026-09-30 14:00–14:45 PT: Security & architecture deep-dive (Marissa, Rishi, Ajay)
- Wed 2026-09-30 15:30–16:00 PT: Procurement / contract items (Neha + procurement rep)
- Artifacts in Drive: network diagram, SOC2 summary (Marissa), technical readout (Rishi)
- Action items before session:
  - Lumenexa: upload redacted network diagram + any inbound/outbound IP allowlist expectations (Priya)
  - Redwood: upload redacted SOC2 PDF and an RBAC/roles doc (Marissa)
  - Redwood SE: 10-slide runbook uploaded (Rishi)

I’m attaching a brief mutual action plan doc and will send calendar invites shortly for both slots. If procurement needs extra time, we can expand the procurement slot to 45m but prefer to keep the security session focused.

Neha Kapoor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: MAP-Lumenexa-Redwood-v1.docx (DOCX, 45KB)]
